t: Cross-Platform Nix Flake for Jupyter & FastHTML
s: This article details the iterative development of a cross-platform Nix `flake.nix` configuration, starting from a minimal Python environment and progressively adding JupyterLab, CUDA support, and FastHTML/HTMX via a virtual environment for a versatile data science and web development setup.
sub: Iterative flake.nix development: Python -> Jupyter -> CUDA -> Virtual Env/FastHTML
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, WSL) development environment setup with Nix.
Integration of data science tools (JupyterLab, pandas, numpy) and GPU acceleration (CUDA).
Handling external Python packages (FastHTML) via a virtual environment within Nix.
Automated environment startup for JupyterLab and FastHTML server.
